evidence: Schema 2 adds structure, growth, water, storms, sailing, gas biology and resources to the coupled product. Tests check conservation (mass, carbon, hydrogen, water), limits, bindings to every producer and input, the schema-1 reference bodies' numbers and exact regeneration. Two read-only agents verified the new sources against what they could read; three read-only agents reviewed the new components' physics and numbers (two first passes and a second pass on the corrections), and their corrections are in this product. No integrated organism, material or flight system is validated.

Numerical review of structure, growth, size limits and ages (read-only agent, independent ledger reproducing every size row to 6e-5 and every age to 0.1 year). Corrected from it: walls between gas cells counted as hydrogen-loss area (overstated loss 1.7-5.3x); the spare superpressure for trim and the fire-barrier skin water left out of the hull and the mass; colony ties renewed yearly instead of with the tendons; the module optimum adding the film floor to the stress film; the nursery fill without the juvenile's gas loss; the colony's start and the nursery juvenile's design; round_case returning unconverged cases; note mismatches (low edge cause, grid edges, tie mass, gust cycles, nursery ranges).

Numerical review of water, storms, sailing, gas biology and resources (read-only agent). Corrected from it: venting share from a 0-90 km mean scale height (about 30% high); entrainment without the gas's own adiabat; flammable reach without the jet's momentum length; lightning ranges quoting one striking distance; tethers sized without their own weight and ballast; ring periods at the hour-mean wind; the lowest sigma level placed by a non-hydrostatic surface pressure; the dry-gap period hard-coded; stores charged for night transpiration; closures read at grid rows; Lewis number one; the plates' equal-loss thickness; falls at one density; note mismatches.

Second numerical review of the corrections (read-only agent, independent recomputation of coupled cases to 1e-6, ages to 0.01 year, circuit periods and dwells by RK4 to 0.001 day). Corrected from it: the gas-cell count settled above the fewest that serve (now scanned up from a lower bound); colony modules without the round bodies' 2.5% seam and ripstop allowance (the smallest passing module moves from 50 to 60 m, which is now the founding module); carbon stops interpolated 1.5-3% low (now bisected on the model); the rain sector's edges counted two ways; the structure tables without the spare superpressure; the hanging-tether search refined; the 40-m raft's column and contact area taken from its hexagonal cells; strikes per century named as such; note mismatches. The point-source fire dose is carried as a sensitivity at one cell radius.
